title: NFTokenPage
key_points: NFTokenPage is a type of account in the XRP Ledger.
It represents an NFT (non-fungible token) holder's account.
The NFTokenPage contains references to one or more NFTs held by the account.
limitations: Limited context beyond the technical documentation
asserts: An NFTokenPage is a specialized account in the XRP Ledger that holds references to one or more non-fungible tokens (NFTs).
scope: Describes the structure and purpose of an NFTokenPage account within the XRP Ledger system.
